method: Separate saved-draft read against native execution logs, production source, frozen contract and leaf receipts
score_reason: Specific APIs, errors and measured checks make scope clear; mandatory headings repeat some limits.
confidence_reason: Parent self-review; no independent human prose assessment.

examples.impact: Prevents fixed-effects numerical checks from becoming a full programme claim
examples.quote: This M1 leaf **does NOT cover** random effects, scale predictors, reference-cohort selection, population abundance, R-to-Julia bridge transport, profile/Wald/bootstrap intervals, or calibrated inference. It also does not claim out-of-sample prediction or accepted simulation behavior. The M2 method draft remains outside package autoload and export paths. Parent-owned export/help integration is present in the shared working tree but was not independently package-checked here.

science_gate_reason: Numerical CJS likelihood and derivative claims have independent fixtures and measured comparisons; calibration and later model classes are excluded.
facts_gate_reason: Accepted gate results and source behavior checked. Leaf environment failures and unretained observations are labelled, not used to establish acceptance. Parent repairs have retained passing logs.
references_gate_reason: No external scientific claim requiring reference verification in these receipts; local evidence and comparator provenance are identified.
calibration_status: No calibration controls were consulted during this assessment
